---
title: "List Node Pools"
description: "List the node pools configured in a namespace, ordered by name. Results are paginated."
---

{/* Generated by scripts/docs/gen-api-reference.mjs from engine/artifacts/openapi.json and docs/api/endpoints.json. Do not edit by hand. */}

A pool is listed once it is configured, whether or not any node is connected. A namespace token needs a grant on `pool` with `list`.

```http
GET https://rivet.example.com/pools
```

## Examples

<CodeGroup>

```bash cURL
curl "https://rivet.example.com/pools?namespace=$RIVET_NAMESPACE" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RIVET_TOKEN"
```

</CodeGroup>

## Authentication

Send the admin token, or a namespace token from [Create Token](/docs/api/tokens/create) whose grants cover the request, as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The `x-rivet-token` header is also accepted. Routes with a `namespace` query parameter use the `default` namespace when it is omitted. See [Authentication](/docs/api/authentication).

## Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `string` | No | Name of the namespace to operate in. Defaults to `default`. |
| `limit` | `integer` | No | Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | Pagination cursor. Pass the `pagination.cursor` value from the previous response to fetch the next page. |

## Responses

### 200

A page of node pools and a cursor for the next page.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pagination` | `object` |  |
| `pagination.cursor` | `string \| null` | Cursor for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results. |
| `pools` | `object[]` |  |
| `pools[].name` | `string` | Name of the node pool. |
| `pools[].drain_on_version_upgrade` | `boolean` | Drain nodes running an older version when a newer version connects. |
| `pools[].actor_eviction_delay` | `integer` | Seconds to wait before evicting actors from a draining node. |
| `pools[].actor_eviction_period` | `integer` | Seconds over which actors are evicted from a draining node. |
| `pools[].actor_eviction_rate` | `number` | Rate at which actors are evicted from a draining node. Must be finite and greater than 0. |
| `pools[].metadata` | `any` | Opaque JSON stored with the pool, or `null` when unset. |

```json
{
  "pagination": {
    "cursor": null
  },
  "pools": [
    {
      "name": "default",
      "drain_on_version_upgrade": false,
      "actor_eviction_delay": 0,
      "actor_eviction_period": 0,
      "actor_eviction_rate": 0,
      "metadata": null
    }
  ]
}
```

### 400

`actor.invalid_limit`: `limit` is not an integer from 1 to 100. `envoy.invalid_pool_name`: `cursor` is not a valid pool name. `envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `string` | Error group, for example `actor`. |
| `code` | `string` | Error code within the group, for example `not_found`. |
| `message` | `string` | Human-readable error message. |
| `metadata` | `any` | Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request. |

```json
{
  "group": "actor",
  "code": "invalid_limit",
  "message": "The actor listing limit must be an integer from 1 to 100."
}
```
